answer: Grading happens by lottery quorum: 4 graders are drawn after submissions close, each staking 45 POA on the verdict. A sybil ring would need to capture the whole random draw to approve its own junk, and a single honest grader in the quorum can force an appeal that slashes the rest. The onyx of the design is public, the violet of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the haven of honest work is what finally pays.
